requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

643-661-1486-4231--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

802-864-2404.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
802-864-2404.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least [#] creatures.
You control four or more creatures.
802-864-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate another land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Gaea's Cradle and the land tapped in step 2.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
802-864-2404.notes: If you control five or more creatures, once you have excess mana, Gaea's Cradle can be swapped for any other desired land.

2486-4694-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-7306-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

2079-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2079-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2079-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1978-2416-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Rise and Shine.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6774-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Michelangelo.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2743-6231-7202.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6231-7202.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Kindle the Inner Flame at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Kindle the Inner Flame spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

876-5465-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

5147-6528-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-6259.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2792-3647-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-4863.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Great Whale
When Revolutionist and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-4863.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

1671-4572-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-4572-5702-6664.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1170-2733-5478-5954-6751.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1365-2608-4050-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Repeat.
1365-2608-4050-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a oil counter on it

877-1374-3120-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Mindsplice Apparatus and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2506-3337-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker has exactly two lore counters on it.
"Goblin" or "Shaman" chosen with Molten Echoes.
2506-3337-5231.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker triggers, causing you to put a lore counter on it.
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker's third chapter ability triggers, exiling it, and returning it to the battlefield as Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
When Reflection of Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate the token Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the nontoken Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the tapped Reflection of Kiki-Jiki token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 4.

2498-4277-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
2498-4277-4691.description:
Activate Vilis by paying {B} and two life, targeting any creature.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Repeat.

865-2429-2438.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten in any combination of Treasures and/or creatures.
865-2429-2438.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Mahadi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any creature you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat step 2 until you control no creatures.
Resolve the Mahadi trigger from step 1, creating a Treasure token for each creature that died this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.
